message: Nothing was changed: 2 blocks cannot be moved by X1 (diameter) Z-0.5: 1 coordinate shift or setting, 1 absolute intermediate point of a return. No machine chosen: a word whose reading depends on the machine would refuse the run.

findings.message: G50 X200. Z100.: this sets or shifts the coordinate system or writes offsets (a local shift, a coordinate set, a data setting that changes offsets); gEdit does not move the values it sets, so the positions after it would no longer match the moved path.
G0 G28 X100.: the return to the reference point goes through this absolute intermediate point, which the transform would move; write it as an incremental zero return or check it by hand.
